candidate: per-row symmetric INT8 full-vocabulary scan plus exact BF16 top-128 rerank
scope: Qwen3.5-0.8B, RTX 4060 Laptop SM89, max_num_seqs=1, batch-1 greedy decode, vLLM fp8_per_block backbone
mechanism: Run a 248320x1024 per-row INT8 GEMV to obtain an approximate full-vocabulary ranking.
Select the approximate top 128 token rows.
Recompute only those rows from the original BF16 tied embedding with FP32 reduction.
Expose -inf outside the shortlist so greedy argmax is decided only by exact BF16 reranked values.

storage.note: The current prototype keeps the original BF16 weight and adds the INT8 cache; it is not yet a load-time ownership-transfer implementation.

search.group32_top2: REJECT: 5/6 natural cases token-exact; translation diverged at token 92
search.group32_top4: PASS screen and 512/512 GSM8K token identity
search.group1024_top128: SELECT: faster formal TPOT with 6/6 natural cases and 512/512 GSM8K token identity

formal_performance.protocol: same-source C-S-S-C, fresh compile cache per process, six natural prompts, 128 output tokens, 3 warmups and 10 trials per case

quality.qualification: Bounded empirical greedy-token identity only; not a proof for all prompts, full-logit equivalence, logprobs, top-p or stochastic sampling.

contract.supported: batch-1 greedy argmax after workload qualification
contract.path_to_guarantee: Add a conservative per-token quantization-error bound and fall back to an exact full-vocabulary scan whenever the approximate shortlist cannot certify inclusion of the BF16 winner.

decision: PROMOTE as the fastest empirically token-identical greedy max_num_seqs=1 policy point in this bounded evaluation. Retain exact-packed BF16 for a strict all-input contract, pure group-32 INT8 for calibrated lossy latency, and native vLLM FP8 for multi-sequence service.
